Subject: RE: Ironvale Plaza LLC - Referral Required

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Ironvale Plaza LLC. I have everything I need to review this risk.

Unfortunately, this one falls outside our current appetite due to coastal exposure. We have at least one location within 16 km of the coast, and our existing portfolio concentration in that area is already quite high, so we're limiting new coastal accumulation at this time.

I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on coastal property risks—they'll be better positioned to provide competitive terms for this exposure.

I appreciate you thinking of us, and please keep us in mind for other opportunities that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
